title: Inform patients of their rights
quote: in advance of furnishing or discontinuing patient care whenever possible
proposedRule: Record that the patient or appropriate representative was informed of patient rights before care is furnished or discontinued whenever possible.
needsCoreFeature: Rights-notice event and admission/care-discontinuation timing
notes: Verified 2026-10-31 against official eCFR XML, title 42 as of 2026-10-29: https://www.ecfr.gov/api/versioner/v1/full/2026-10-29/title-42.xml?part=482.

title: Respect the right to refuse treatment
quote: being able to request or refuse treatment
proposedRule: Allow a documented treatment refusal and route it for appropriate clinical handling instead of requiring an affirmative acceptance to complete every care path.
needsCoreFeature: Patient treatment decision and refusal branch
notes: Verified 2026-10-31 against official eCFR XML, title 42 as of 2026-10-29: https://www.ecfr.gov/api/versioner/v1/full/2026-10-29/title-42.xml?part=482. This is a patient right, not a mandate for a specific refusal checkbox or permission to demand medically unnecessary care.

title: Honor applicable advance directives
quote: comply with these directives
proposedRule: Make applicable advance directives available to treating staff and preserve a care path consistent with them.
needsCoreFeature: Advance-directive content, applicability and care consistency
notes: Verified 2026-10-31 against official eCFR XML, title 42 as of 2026-10-29: https://www.ecfr.gov/api/versioner/v1/full/2026-10-29/title-42.xml?part=482. advanceDirectiveAsked is optional and accidental in v1; asking about a directive is not compliance with its content.

title: Seclusion is limited to violent or self-destructive behavior
quote: Seclusion may only be used for the management of violent or self-destructive behavior.
proposedRule: Do not authorize seclusion for a nonviolent, non-self-destructive patient.
needsCoreFeature: Restraint/seclusion events, patient predicates and validated order state
notes: Verified 2026-10-31 against official eCFR XML, title 42 as of 2026-10-29: https://www.ecfr.gov/api/versioner/v1/full/2026-10-29/title-42.xml?part=482.  Related earlier research: docs/regulations.md R2-19; these rows split its federal requirements.
